(उत्तरी रेलवे) , जिला फतेहगढ़ साजहब, पंिाब राज्य में , के जनष्पािन हेतु आवश्यक है , एतिद्वारा उक्त भूजम के अजधग्र हण का अपना अजभप्राय घोजषत करती है। उक्त भूजम में रु जच रखने वाला कोई भी व्य जक्त , इस अजधसूचना के रािपत्र में प्र कािन की जतजर् से 30 दिनों की अवजध के भीतर, उक्त उद्देश्य हेतु भूजम के अजधग्रहण के जवरुद्ध , उक्त अजधजनयम की धारा 20 डी के अंतगात आपजत्त प्रस्ट् तुत कर सकता है। प्रत् येक आपजत्त सिम प्र ाजधकारी , अर्ाात् उप -मंडल मजिस्ट्रेट , बस्ट्सी पठाना , जिला फतेहगढ़ साजहब, पंिाब, को जलजखत रू प में प्रस्ट् तुत की िाएगी तर्ा उसमें आपजत्त के आधार स्ट् पष्ट रू प से उल्लेजखत होंगे। सिम MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS [Northern Railway (Construction Organization)] NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 23rd April, 2026 S.O. 2069(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of Section 20A of the Railways Act, 1989 (24 of 89)(hereinafter referred as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, brief description of which is given in the schedule annexed hereto, is required for execution of Special Railway Project, notification no. S.O. 4854 (E) dated 24 October 2025, namely, Rajpura-Mohali New Rail Line (18.11 KM) of Northern Railway, in Fatehgarh Sahib District in the State of Punjab, hereby declares its intention to such land; Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of 30 days from the date of publication of this notification in the official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub- section 20 D of the said Act; Every objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Bassi Pathana, District Fatehgarh Sahib, Punjab, in writing and shall set out grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector and opportunity of being heard, either in person or through a legal practitioner, and may , after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections; Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be final; The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority. Brief Description of the land to be acquired, with or without structure, for the Special Railway Project, namely, Rajpura-Mohali New Railway Line (18.11 KM) of Northern Railway, in Fatehgarh Sahib District in the State of Punjab.
